pachirisu.name: Pachirisu
dialog: Chipa! Chipa-chii!

keira.name: Keira
dialog: Buneary, wait for me!

pokefan_m_2.name: Man
dialog: The Day Care couple found an Egg on my Pokémon's account! I had no idea where it came from.

hiker_2.name: Hiker
dialog: Eggs turn up at the Day Care out in Johto as well, I hear. Pokémon are the same everywhere!

pokefan_m_1.name: Man
dialog: So, which is it to be first: the Gym, or a contest?
Win a Badge or win a ribbon. Either way, Hearthome will cheer you on.

pokemon_breeder_f_1.name: Woman
dialog: Since I started pushing a pram, I see every step and every kerb in this city.
Before, I never noticed a single one!

pokemon_breeder_m_1.name: Man
dialog: People here say hello to strangers, and they mean it.
There's something about this city that makes everyone open up.

pokefan_f.name: Woman
dialog: How many kinds of Pokémon do you suppose there are in the world?
Every time I think I've met them all, a new one turns up.

mr_goods.name: Mr. Goods
dialog: People call me Mr. Goods. I collect fine things, and I give them away to trainers who've earned them.
Do something truly remarkable, and come and tell me about it.

battle_girl_1.name: Girl
dialog: A ribbon, a hat, or a flower behind the ear?
I can never decide what my Pokémon should wear on stage at a contest!

battle_girl_2.name: Girl
dialog: I used a Fire Stone on my Pokémon, and it evolved right there in my hands!
Some Pokémon won't evolve however much they battle. They need the right stone.

hiker_1.name: Hiker
dialog: I walk my Pachirisu round Amity Square every morning, just north of here.
Big as I am, it's the one setting the pace!

black_belt_1.name: Black Belt
dialog: For years I trained alone on a mountain, with nobody to talk to.
Then I came down to Hearthome. Now I can't walk ten steps without someone wanting a chat!

pokemon_breeder_m_2.name: Man
dialog: One day my little one will be old enough for a Pokémon of their own.
I wonder which Pokémon they'll make friends with first?

pokemon_breeder_f_2.name: Woman
dialog: I'm only visiting, but I'd love to live here one day.
Hearthome feels like home the moment you arrive.

artist.name: Artist
dialog: I come to this spot every day to paint the city.
The light on these streets is never the same twice. I don't think I'll ever finish!

black_belt_2.name: Black Belt
dialog: Ghost-type Pokémon don't feel Normal or Fighting moves at all.
I learnt that one the hard way, against this city's Gym.
